opportunities.name: Siphon Shadow Refresh
opportunities.objective: Record W tick healing events and actual cooldown changes.
opportunities.mechanic: W cooldown falls 5% each time P heals Morgana; P heals from ability damage on specific eligible units. W damage rises with missing health, so Shadowflame can enhance late magic ticks. Blackfire and Riftmaker test persistent damage/ramp while Rylai helps hold eligible champions in W.
opportunities.requiredState: Q holds an eligible champion in W with a finite combat/mana duration.
opportunities.failure: Ordinary small minions do not grant P healing and mobile enemies leave the zone.
opportunities.test: Record W tick healing events and actual cooldown changes; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Extra item damage is not automatically Morgana ability damage that heals P.

opportunities.name: Shackle Shield Ally Charge
opportunities.objective: Log R completion and Helia charges spent by allied E.
opportunities.mechanic: R has immediate and three-second delayed magic damage/stun plus movement during casting. E can shield another ally and consume Helia charges from Morgana's champion damage; Staff improves subsequent shields. Zhonya tests surviving the tether while Mandate uses Q or completed R stun.
opportunities.requiredState: Keep R tether until completion and shield an ally after damage rather than only self.
opportunities.failure: Enemy breaks tether or magic shield breaks before protecting the ally.
opportunities.test: Log R completion and Helia charges spent by allied E; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Black Shield prevents control only while intact and is not an all-damage shield.

ruledOut.reason: P has specific eligible target categories and ability-damage healing; ordinary attack lifesteal does not imply W healing.

unknowns: P eligibility, item damage ownership and R continuation during stasis require live checks.

builds.name: Siphon Shadow Refresh
builds.summary: Record W tick healing events and actual cooldown changes.
builds.goal: Record W tick healing events and actual cooldown changes.
builds.hypothesis: W cooldown falls 5% each time P heals Morgana; P heals from ability damage on specific eligible units. W damage rises with missing health, so Shadowflame can enhance late magic ticks. Blackfire and Riftmaker test persistent damage/ramp while Rylai helps hold eligible champions in W.
testPlan: Required state: Q holds an eligible champion in W with a finite combat/mana duration.
Record W tick healing events and actual cooldown changes; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Ordinary small minions do not grant P healing and mobile enemies leave the zone.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Extra item damage is not automatically Morgana ability damage that heals P.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blackfire Torch, Riftmaker, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Morgana Heals for [18]% of the damage dealt by her Abilities to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungle monsters.

While casting this Ability, Morgana gains [20 / 40 / 60]% Move Speed.
